# quickwit_field_object (Data Source)

Builds an `object` field mapping from child field mappings (themselves outputs of `quickwit_field_*` data sources).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "quickwit_field_text" "service_name" {
  name      = "name"
  tokenizer = "raw"
}

data "quickwit_field_numeric" "service_port" {
  name = "port"
  type = "u64"
}

# Objects nest the JSON of other field data sources (recursively).
data "quickwit_field_object" "service" {
  name = "service"
  field_mappings = [
    data.quickwit_field_text.service_name.json,
    data.quickwit_field_numeric.service_port.json,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `field_mappings` (List of String) Child field mappings, as JSON documents (`data.quickwit_field_*.x.json`). Must not be empty.
- `name` (String) Field name. Dots must be escaped (`\\.`) to be part of the name.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) Canonical JSON document (all defaults explicit, keys sorted), as returned by Quickwit.
